en_title: Ben Wang Reportedly in Talks to Play Iceman in MCU X-Men Reboot
cn_title: 据报道Ben Wang正洽谈在MCU的X-Men重启电影中饰演Iceman
opus_summary: 据Deadline报道，Ben Wang正洽谈在MCU《X-Men》重启电影中饰演Iceman，他是参与该角色试镜的数名演员之一。影片由Jake Schreier执导，计划于2028年5月5日上映；Marvel已确认Inde Navarrette、Sadie Sink等人参演。

paragraphs.en: The Long Walk actor Ben Wang is reportedly in talks to play Iceman in the MCU's upcoming X-Men reboot.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《The Long Walk》演员Ben Wang正洽谈在MCU即将推出的《X-Men》重启电影中饰演Iceman。

paragraphs.en: Deadline reported that Wang, who will soon appear as Wyatt Callow in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , is circling the role of Marvel's icy mutant hero, Bobby Drake. He's said to be one of a few other names who have tested for the part, with other allegedly interested names including Gabriel LaBelle (The Fabelmans), Jackson Kelly (The Pitt), and Rhenzy Feliz (The Penguin).
paragraphs.cn: Deadline报道称，即将在《The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping》中饰演Wyatt Callow的Wang正在接洽Marvel的冰系变种人英雄Bobby Drake一角。据说他是参加过该角色试镜的几名演员之一，据称其他有意出演的演员还包括Gabriel LaBelle（《The Fabelmans》）、Jackson Kelly（《The Pitt》）和Rhenzy Feliz（《The Penguin》）。

paragraphs.en: More than anything, news of Wang's potential involvement suggests Marvel at least has plans for Iceman to play a role in the 2028 X-Men film. The character may not have the star power of a Wolverine or Cyclops, but he's remained an important figure in the comic book history for decades. In addition to a variety of appearances throughout animated projects and video games, he was famously played by Shawn Ashmore in live-action movies like the original 2000 X-Men, its two sequels, and X-Men: Days of Future Past.
paragraphs.cn: Wang可能参演的消息最重要的是表明，Marvel至少计划让Iceman在2028年的《X-Men》电影中占有一席之地。这个角色或许没有Wolverine或Cyclops那样的明星影响力，但几十年来，他一直是漫画史上的重要人物。除了多次出现在动画作品和电子游戏中，他还曾在2000年的首部《X-Men》、其两部续集以及《X-Men: Days of Future Past》等真人电影中由Shawn Ashmore饰演，这一演绎广为人知。

paragraphs.en: Wang has found his way to more than a few notable roles in his relatively short amount of time in Hollywood. After playing smaller parts in projects like the MacGyver reboot series, The Last O.G., and 2023's Sight, the actor went on to show up in 2024's Mean Girls and Karate Kid: Legends.
paragraphs.cn: Wang在Hollywood的时间相对较短，却已出演了不少引人注目的角色。在《MacGyver》重启剧集、《The Last O.G.》和2023年的《Sight》等作品中饰演小角色后，他又出演了2024年的《Mean Girls》和《Karate Kid: Legends》。

paragraphs.en: Audiences really started to catch on when he played Hank Olson in the gruesome 2025 adaptation of Stephen King's The Long Walk, with even more set to see what he can do in The Hunger Games prequel later this month. X-Men will surely only open that door further should talks proceed accordingly.
paragraphs.cn: 当他在根据Stephen King的《The Long Walk》改编、于2025年推出的血腥电影中饰演Hank Olson时，观众才真正开始关注他。本月晚些时候，还会有更多观众在《The Hunger Games》前传中看到他的表现。如果洽谈顺利推进，《X-Men》肯定会进一步为他打开这扇门。

paragraphs.en: Marvel has already confirmed a small collection of heavy hitters for its upcoming take on classic superhero characters. The list so far includes Inde Navarrette as Rogue, Sadie Sink as Jean Grey , Adam Driver as Mister Sinister, Christopher Abbott as Professor X, Kit Connor as Cyclops , Maya Boyd as Storm, and Samara Weaving as Emma Frost . Gen V actor Asa Germann was reported to have joined as Angel in September.
paragraphs.cn: Marvel已经为其即将推出的经典超级英雄角色新作确认了少数几位重量级演员。目前的名单包括饰演Rogue的Inde Navarrette、饰演琴·葛蕾的Sadie Sink、饰演Mister Sinister的Adam Driver、饰演Professor X的Christopher Abbott、饰演Cyclops的Kit Connor、饰演Storm的Maya Boyd，以及饰演Emma Frost的Samara Weaving。据报道，《Gen V》演员Asa Germann于9月加盟，饰演Angel。

paragraphs.en: X-Men is being directed by Thunderbolts* director Jake Schreier and is scheduled to come to theaters May 5, 2028. For now, we'll have to wait to see if Wang lands the part. In the meantime, the old-school X-Men are set to kick off one last hurrah with the release of next month's Avengers: Doomsday . Whether or not Ashmore's Iceman will return for that team-up film remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 《X-Men》由《Thunderbolts*》导演Jake Schreier执导，计划于2028年5月5日上映。眼下，我们还得等待，看Wang能否拿下这个角色。与此同时，随着《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》下个月上映，老一代X-Men将开启最后一次狂欢。Ashmore饰演的Iceman是否会在这部集结电影中回归，仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: For more on X-Men, you can see Navarrette tease her take on Rogue's Southern accent . You can also read about what Abbott had to say regarding any cameos between now and 2028 .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多有关《X-Men》的消息，可以看看Navarrette如何透露她对Rogue南方口音的演绎。你也可以读读Abbott对从现在到2028年期间可能出现的任何客串有何说法。
